description: Returns the framework’s notes for one jurisdiction, and which stored AI instruments apply to a task in a court or tribunal. Name the forum, or court "no" when no court is involved. A gap means no instrument is stored for that forum. It also returns the jurisdiction’s recorded answers on telling the court and the client, with their basis and sources, and the instruments its page lists with their dates (up to 30, instruments before notes; ai_rules_more counts the rest). A row of kind no_guidance_note records that none was found. Each instrument’s summary is on the page at md_url.

court.description: no when no court or tribunal is involved.

document_type.description: The kind of document, when it is one of these.

forum.description: A forum code such as "ncat", "federal-court" or "vcat". Omit it to be asked which court applies.

jurisdiction.description: A jurisdiction id or slug, for example "NSW", "VIC", "new-zealand".

personal_information.description: True when the work puts personal information into an AI product.

task.description: What the work is, in a short phrase. Used to recognise the document and the subject.

name: get_jurisdiction_guidance
title: Get a jurisdiction’s guidance
